title: Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality.   We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence

translated_title: 探索强化学习在生成式推荐模型中的应用
translated_abstract: 传统的级联式推荐系统在大规模物品空间上权衡准确性与效率，但各阶段目标不一致阻碍了端到端优化。生成式推荐在自回归框架中统一了这些阶段，为强化学习（RL）优化整个生成过程提供了天然的接口。然而，直接应用强化学习往往导致优化不稳定和推荐质量下降。我们通过统一的logit梯度视角重新审视了组相对策略优化（GRPO）以及其他基于比率的 目标。我们识别出三个问题： 裁剪代理会产生死梯度区域，导致样本利用率不足； 负优势更新可能随着重要性比率的增长而实际上变得无界，使得一小部分负样本主导优化过程； 基于比率的控制缺乏对绝对策略置信度的敏感性，因此对高置信度的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过统一的logit梯度视角重新审视GRPO等基于比率的强化学习目标，识别出裁剪代理产生死梯度、负优势更新随重要性比率增长而实际无界、以及对绝对策略置信度缺乏敏感性这三个导致生成式推荐中强化学习优化不稳定的关键问题。
en_tdlr: This paper revisits GRPO and other ratio-based RL objectives through a unified logit-gradient view, identifying three key issues—dead-gradient regions from clipped surrogates, effectively unbounded negative-advantage updates as importance ratios grow, and insensitivity to absolute policy confidence—that cause unstable optimization in generative recommendation.
